verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Basecamp supports external AI agents: you can invite AI agents into projects, connect ChatGPT and Claude through MCP, and use a CLI and skills for agents running on your own computer. None of it documents a built-in AI assistant inside Basecamp that you can delegate tasks to. External-agent integration is an adjacent capability, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
